narr: A complex of thunderstorms along a cold front moved across southern Wisconsin causing locally damaging winds, large hail and flash flooding. A tornado occurred near Evansville.
ev: Water flowing over a portion of highway 126 near Belmont. Portions of roads flooded in or near Benton, Shullsburg, Darlington, South Wayne and Gratiot. A culvert washed out near Benton.

Many roads closed due to high water on the east side of the county with some shoulder washouts. More specifically, there was scouring of pavement and shoulder material on County Road E just south of the Norwegian Creek bridge.
Street flooding in Kenosha and Pleasant Prairie with water up to the bottom of vehicles.
